basic_info.description: Spacious and centrally located, this two bedroom condo with deeded parking is a great value. Outdoor patio off the primary bedroom. Laundry in unit. New carpet and freshly painted throughout. Easy, single level access in elevator building. Down payment assistance may be possible. Property is subject to the resale procedures. The City and County of San Francisco holds the right of first refusal. City Second Loan Program is available for qualified buyers on a first come, first served basis. Visit https://sfmohcd.org/city-second-details for application and program information.
